en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story masonry townhouses, dominated in the foreground by a large, ornate corner building with classical details (rusticated ground floor, pilasters, pediments over windows, and an attic pediment with a circular opening). Leafless trees line the left side of the street; several people stand near doorways and on the sidewalk. The scene suggests a small European town in the late 19th or early 20th century.
